hypothesis: At a fixed causal observation time, buy the complementary token whose top-book depth pressure is stronger, but only when the cross-token pressure gap is wide, has widened over the preceding 15 seconds, and both books retain a narrow spread.

allowed_inputs: up/down top bid and ask depth
up/down top-book pressure at observation and observation minus 15 seconds
visible selected-token ask depth and fixed fee economics
forbidden_inputs: external model probability or model edge

cheap_screen.older_gate: positive point edge above fee-aware break-even
cheap_screen.recent_gate: point edge above 0.02 and positive fee-aware payoff proxy

fresh_holdout_policy: Fresh outcomes remain physically unavailable unless a frozen exact-replay trace clears the advancement gate.
terminal_rule: After the bounded exact replay, advance once to the fresh gate or reject the family. Positive point PnL cannot authorize more hours, variants, or replay traces.
